# Libraries

```{r}
suppressMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressMessages(library(data.table))
suppressMessages(library(magrittr))
library(ggplot2)
library(devtools)
library(rsample)

CENSUS_YEAR = 2018.5
MALAWI_CENSUS_POP = 17563749

pop_scaling_factor = 97.23887 # Change reports to overlap with census year

```

# Initial test - baseline

```{r}
input_path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/Malawi/HIVMC_AI/Baseline-campaign_Malawi_20251209_AI_baseline-hivcontrol_baseline___2025_12_10_16_30_28_229595"

sim.results <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = input_path,
  scenario_name = 'baseline.test',
  summarize_columns = c("Newly.Infected", "Newly.Tested.Positive", "Newly.Tested.Negative",
                        "Population","Infected", "On_ART","Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Diagnosed", "Initiate_Background_PrEP"),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "Age", "IP_Key.Risk", "IP_Key.ARTStatus", "IP_Key.OnPrEP"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
) %>% 
  ungroup()

sim.results$pop.scaling.factor <- pop_scaling_factor
```

## PLHIV - all adults

```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.ix, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(Infected = mean(Infected)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

## PLHIV by age
```{r}

```

## HIV Deaths by ART status
```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 35) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Died_from_HIV = Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor, .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  mutate(mort = Died_from_HIV/Infected)
```

```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 35) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Died_from_HIV = Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor, .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  mutate(mort = Died_from_HIV/Infected)

```

## New Acquisitions

```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.ix, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

## ART Coverage - 90-90-90

### VLS - under 35
```{r}
onart_dat <- sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age < 35, Age >= 15) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.ix, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop.scaling.factor),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop.scaling.factor)
    ) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected), 
    Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed),
    On_ART = mean(On_ART)) %>% 
  ungroup()

onart_dat %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Year, scenario_name, Gender), 
    names_from = IP_Key.ARTStatus,
    values_from = On_ART
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tot = OnEffectiveART + OnNonSuppressiveART 
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    VLS = OnEffectiveART/tot
  )

```
### VLS - over 35
```{r}
onart_dat <- sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 35) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.ix, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop.scaling.factor),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop.scaling.factor)
    ) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected), 
    Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed),
    On_ART = mean(On_ART)) %>% 
  ungroup()

onart_dat %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Year, scenario_name, Gender), 
    names_from = IP_Key.ARTStatus,
    values_from = On_ART
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tot = OnEffectiveART + OnNonSuppressiveART 
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    VLS = OnEffectiveART/tot
  )

```

## Count interventions

```{r}
intven.dat <- sim.results.test %>% 
  filter(Year >= 15) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year - .5)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Initiate_Background_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Background_PrEP * pop.scaling.factor), 
    Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * pop.scaling.factor),
    OnART1_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer * pop.scaling.factor), 
    HIV_SelfTest = sum(HIV_SelfTest * pop.scaling.factor), 
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = sum(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * pop.scaling.factor),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = sum(NonSuppressiveART_staging * pop.scaling.factor),
    EffectiveART = sum(EffectiveART * pop.scaling.factor),
    NonSuppressiveART = sum(NonSuppressiveART * pop.scaling.factor),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Initiate_Background_PrEP = mean(Initiate_Background_PrEP),
    Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = mean(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP), 
    OnART1_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_defaulter_tracer), 
    HIV_SelfTest = mean(HIV_SelfTest),
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = mean(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = mean(NonSuppressiveART_staging),
    EffectiveART = mean(EffectiveART), 
    NonSuppressiveART = mean(NonSuppressiveART),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  )

#View(intven.dat %>% arrange(Year, scenario_name, Gender))

```

```{r}
intven.dat %>%
```

## Any detectable impact on HIV acquisitions or deaths across the scenarios?



### Under 35
```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age < 35, Age >=- 15) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor), 
    Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Died_from_HIV, Newly.Infected),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = value, color = scenario_name)) + 
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Gender), rows = vars(metric),
            scales = "free_y")
```

### Over 35
```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 35) %>%

  summarize(

            scales = "free_y")
```

## Look at PrEP coverage

```{r}
prep.cov.dat <- sim.results %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender, IP_Key.OnPrEP) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population * pop.scaling.factor), .groups ='drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender, IP_Key.OnPrEP) %>% 
  summarize(Population = mean(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  select(scenario_name, Year, Gender, PrEP = IP_Key.OnPrEP, Population) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(scenario_name, Year, Gender), 
    names_from = PrEP, 
    names_prefix = "PrEP_",
    values_from = Population
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tot = PrEP_FALSE + PrEP_TRUE
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    coverage = PrEP_TRUE/tot
  )
```

```{r}
prep.cov.dat %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(x = Year, y = PrEP_TRUE, color = scenario_name) 
  ) + 
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Gender))
```


```{r}
prep.cov.dat %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(x = Year, y = coverage, color = scenario_name) 
  ) + 
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Gender))
```

## Count interventions

How many people are receiving the intervention - in excess of baseline effectiveART

There's actually versions of this where we implement improved VLS and actually see decrease in the numbers of EffectiveART uptake

```{r}
sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15 ) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year - .5)) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, Year, scenario_name, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
   EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = sum(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * pop.scaling.factor),
   NonSuppressiveART_staging = sum(NonSuppressiveART_staging * pop.scaling.factor)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = mean(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = mean(NonSuppressiveART_staging)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Year, Gender),
    names_from = scenario_name,
    values_from = c(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services, NonSuppressiveART_staging)
  )

sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15 ) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year - .5)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = sum(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * pop.scaling.factor),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = sum(NonSuppressiveART_staging * pop.scaling.factor),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender) %>% 
  summarize(
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = mean(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = mean(NonSuppressiveART_staging),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Year, Gender),
    names_from = scenario_name,
    values_from = c(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services, NonSuppressiveART_staging)
  )
```

## Define functions
```{r}
bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

calculate.CI.by.metric = function(data, scenario.name, metric, n = 500){
  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name), times = n)
  
  bt_resamples$mean.metric <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, metric)
  metric_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.metric, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  return(
      data.frame(
      scenario_name = scenario.name, 
      metric = metric,
      metric.mean = mean(bt_resamples$mean.metric),
      metric.lb = metric_95[[1]], 
      metric.ub = metric_95[[2]]
    )
  )
}

format_sig3 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(val) > 0 & abs(val) < 1) {
      formatC(signif(val, 3), digits=3, format="fg", flag="#")
    } else {
      formatC(round(val), format="d")
    }
  }, character(1))
}
```

```{r}
time.series.metrics.disaggregated <- sim.results %>%

            PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,

            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,

            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor), 
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = PLHIV - On_ART)
```
